title: Portuguese-Style Casserole
description: A hearty casserole with juicy meat and fresh tomatoes, inspired by traditional Portuguese flavors.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, beef broth, and casserole.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Transfer casserole mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
